title: Submit an explicitly approved RF filing
description:
If authority.12 identifies a required and human-selected filing, prepare and submit only the specifically approved equipment-change or experimental application. Bind its applicant, content, measurements and configuration to the reviewed record. No filing path or applicant commitment is selected by this placeholder.

HPC8 execution policy: Code, test, or schema changes require three independent correctness, security, and robustness reviews; file and fix all findings and re-review. Use independent oracles, never weakened legacy tests or self-generated expected results. Preserve upstream Yggdrasil addressing, radio-owned identity, best-effort custody, baseline SCHC, and the human-only OSCORE/EDHOC security edit bar. External actions, hardware/RF operations, and port access require scoped explicit permission and applicable bench safety checks. Research may conclude no-go; an authorization gate requires affirmative, recorded approval for its actual scope. Dependency closure and decomposition are not permission. No speculative activation, including deferred portability or experimental modes.
design: Do not become a prerequisite for measurements already permitted under a distinct test authority. No automatic activation follows completion. A new grant returns for human disposition review without adding a reverse dependency to authority.12. Further correspondence and purchases require separate permission.
acceptance_criteria: Remain deferred unless the particular submission is approved: Require recorded, scoped, explicit approval from Mark for the named action. Approval must identify required filing status, applicant, complete content, fees if any and submission action. Denial or no required filing is a valid no-go or not-applicable disposition, not permission to submit. Record submission, acknowledgement, grant, denial and conditions separately. A submitted or acknowledged application is not operating permission.
